invariants.expression: inFlightInstantTimestamp != null && inFlightInstantTimestamp.isPresent() == true || config.isMetadataTableEnabled() == false
invariants.rationale: Since the method returns early if metadata table is disabled, or proceeds and uses inFlightInstantTimestamp, at exit either metadata is disabled, or timestamp is present.

meta.value: If metadata table is not enabled, method returns early; otherwise inFlightInstantTimestamp must be present.

invariants.rationale: The metaClient parameter is not modified or set to null, so it remains non-null.

meta.value: metaClient is a parameter and expected to be non-null at method exit.

invariants.rationale: When metadata table is enabled, metaClient reloadTableConfig might have been called to update table config.

meta.value: If metadata table is enabled, metaClient has reloaded table config or it is already set.

invariants.rationale: This is a safe null check on inFlightInstantTimestamp if metadata table is enabled.

meta.value: If metadata table is enabled, inFlightInstantTimestamp must not be null as it is used to create the writer.
Trivially true invariant, included as fallback.
